meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用日历的 +agenda 和待办的 +get-my-tasks，把指定日期的日程与未完成待办整理成一份摘要，含时间、组织者、参与状态、时间冲突提醒和空闲时段。
howto.when: 当你说“今天有什么安排”“明天有什么会”“这周还有哪些安排”等，或要早报、开工摘要时触发。仅支持 user 身份，需先授权 calendar 与 task。

say.text: 帮我看看今天的日程和待办
明天有什么会？顺便列一下未完成任务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls the calendar +agenda and task +get-my-tasks commands, then combines the given date's events and unfinished to-dos into one summary with times, organizers, RSVP status, overlap alerts and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask things like "what's on today", "any meetings tomorrow", or "what's left this week", or request a standup report. User identity only; requires calendar and task authorization first.

say_en.text: Show me today's schedule and to-dos
What meetings do I have tomorrow? Also list open tasks
What else is scheduled this week?
